findings.title: bin.kogler.si NXDOMAIN (live) despite IaC + doc claim public
findings.proposed_fix: owner: run `bash scripts/ansible-run.sh dns.yml` from the home control plane (the cloudflare_api token is IP-filtered to 193.77.156.222 per the IaC comment). Then bin.kogler.si will resolve to vps.kogler.si CNAME.

findings.title: traefik.kogler.si RESOLVES (live) despite IaC + doc saying tailnet-only — STALE Cloudflare record

matrix.kogler.si is consistent across doc + IaC + live (fully public per HD-46/47)
